svg.title: deadreckon app icon
svg.desc: The committed world at 1024px: dark charcoal instrument face, hard-line geometry, the one warm orange spent on the brand mark. Two hues — charcoal (field #1D1C1A + hairline edge #32302C) and orange (#E2703A lit facet, #D0662F shade facet). Flat fills only: no gradients, no shadows, no gloss. Geometry (DESIGN.md §8, SETTINGS-SCREENS-SPEC.md §I): tile 824×824 at (100,100), corner radius 185 (macOS icon grid) edge 10-unit inner stroke, outer edge flush with the tile edge mark 45° diamond, half-diagonal 270, centered at (512,512), split along the vertical diagonal into two flat facets 16px survival: the facet values are ~8% apart in luminance, so at small sizes the mark reads as one solid orange diamond on a charcoal tile; the edge line disappears politely. Render every AppIcon slot from this file at its exact pixel size — never downscale a single raster.
